summary: Iterates a strided array owned by `this` and calls sub_4CB5E0 once per element. The element count is read from this+0x10; the first element pointer is read from this+0x14; consecutive elements are 108 bytes apart. When the count is not positive the loop is skipped and the function returns the count.

operations.description: Read the element count from this+0x10 into result and seed the loop counter.
Proceed only when the count is positive; otherwise the loop body never runs.
do-while loop that runs until the per-iteration counter reaches the element count.
Call sub_4CB5E0 on each element: base pointer from this+0x14 plus the current strided index.
Advance the element index by 108 bytes after each call.
Return the element count read from this+0x10.

clean_pseudocode: do { sub_4CB5E0(this[5] + off); off += 108; ++i; } while (i < count);
